target: the pr-open gate must be specific to hardened specs — a standard spec advances exactly as before, with no report required.
cmd:
printf -- "---
id: 960
title: t
status: reviewing
profile: standard
depends_on:
claimed_by:
branch:
pr:
---
" > s.md; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance s.md pr-open >/dev/null 2>&1; c=$?; st=$(grep -m1 "^status:" s.md|sed "s/status: //"); printf '{"c":%s,"status":"%s"}' "$c" "$st"
